name: What steps are involved in interior water damage repair?

mainEntity.name: What steps are involved in interior water damage repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Water damage interior repair addresses the structural and cosmetic damage left after a leak or flood has been stopped and dried out. The process begins with cutting away compromised drywall, insulation, and warped baseboards to verify the framing is sound and moisture-free. Next, crews hang new drywall, tape, mud, texture, and prime the surface. If floors or trim were damaged, subfloor repair, finish carpentry, and tile installation follow. Finally, painters blend the paint seamlessly with undamaged sections. Because hidden dampness behind walls can ruin fresh repairs, a professional general contractor ensures framing cavities are completely dry before closing walls back up.
acceptedAnswer.description: Interior repair involves removing ruined drywall and insulation, inspecting framing, hanging and texturing new sheetrock, replacing trim or tile, and applying matching paint.
